test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Transform the following sentence into active voice.

The tree was felled by the farmer.

options.text: The farmer has felled the tree.
The farmer fell from the tree.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action, and the object receives the action.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The tree was felled by the farmer."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the farmer" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was felled" to "felled" (simple past active).
 
• Ensure the object "the tree" follows the verb to complete the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The farmer felled the tree."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The farmer has felled the tree." – Incorrect tense (present perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"The farmer fell from the tree." – Incorrect meaning (refers to the farmer falling).
 
• **Option 3: **"The farmer fell the tree." – Incorrect verb form.
